sources.entry: yovoice - Local voice creation studio with text-to-speech, voice cloning, emotion control, song generation and MIDI scoring, all running on-device. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/leemysw/yovoice) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: yovoice
summary.one_liner: yovoice is a free, open-source desktop workstation that runs AI voice cloning, text-to-speech, song generation and MIDI arrangement entirely on your own computer.
use_cases: clone a voice from a short reference recording
generate songs or instrumental music from lyrics and style prompts
compose and render multitrack MIDI arrangements
batch voiceover generation via CLI or agent tools
summary.what_it_does: The app extracts a voice from an uploaded or recorded reference clip, or designs a new voice from a text description. It supports story voiceover, speech synthesis with emotion control, and generation of full songs, instrumentals and sound effects using a range of bundled models such as IndexTTS, VoxCPM2, Kokoro, ACE-Step, YuE2 and Stable Audio 3. A multitrack MIDI editor renders arrangements with General MIDI soundfonts that need no GPU, and MIDI can be imported and exported. Generated audio gets automatic checks for clipping, clicks, truncation and long silences, and can be exported to audiobook, podcast or video loudness targets. It offers a CLI, HTTP API and MCP support for scripting and AI agents; assets are stored in a local ~/.yovoice directory.
notable: Fully local, offline-capable generation with data kept in ~/.yovoice
Multitrack MIDI arrangement using General MIDI sound banks that do not need a GPU
Automatic audio quality checks and LUFS loudness export targets
Optional AI assistant (DeepSeek, Qwen, OpenAI, Ollama, etc.) for writing arrangements and lyrics; software is Apache-2.0
caveats: Several bundled models are non-commercial only (OmniVoice, YuE2, Breeze TTS 2); Stable Audio 3 uses a community license with revenue limits; commercial use depends on each model's license
Song and music generation need 12GB+ VRAM or Apple Silicon 16GB+; high-quality cloning needs 4-6GB VRAM or Apple Silicon 8GB+
Platform support: macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon only, Windows 10/11 x64, Linux x64 (Debian/Ubuntu)
